title: What states the resolution of each published number, and what admits that nothing does
note: D-2026-66. The only instrument reporting on D-2026-53's discipline examined a column only when it happened to cross zero between two environments, so the coverage it implied was a fact about which machines had run. Measured over every governed column it was 19 of 162. N1 is the operator that matters: it removes the within-artefact rule, and the residual goes back to carrying a class while the maximum and the region mean beside it in the same row, out of the same solve, against the same floor, stay bare -- closing the example instead of the class. N2-N3 let a carrier be named without being checked. N4-N5 drop one direction of the reconciliation each. N6 accepts an empty scope. N7 lets a column be exempted without saying why.

mutations.name: N1_a_bare_column_beside_a_declared_one_is_tolerated
mutations.find: if not any(declared[k].get("basis") == "CARRIER" for k in keys):
mutations.rationale: the within-artefact rule stops existing, so a quantity published bare beside one that declares its resolution -- same row, same solve, same floor -- is accepted; that is D-2026-53 closed on its example

mutations.name: N2_a_carrier_is_taken_on_trust
mutations.find: bad = sorted({v for v in values if v not in CLASSES})
mutations.rationale: any column may be nominated as a carrier regardless of what it holds; naming a column becomes carrying a class, which is the proxy this package keeps finding

mutations.name: N3_a_carrier_that_does_not_exist_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an inventory can name a resolution column that is not in the artefact at all and still reconcile

mutations.name: N4_a_governed_column_nobody_classified_is_not_reported
mutations.rationale: a new column enters the schema unclassified and the inventory keeps reporting full coverage of the columns it happens to know about

mutations.name: N5_a_declaration_for_a_departed_column_is_not_reported
mutations.rationale: the inventory drifts into describing a schema that has moved on, which is how a coverage number outlives its subject

mutations.name: N6_an_empty_scope_reports_full_coverage
mutations.rationale: a moved unit inventory or a changed key format yields no columns, and every reconciliation below agrees over nothing

mutations.name: N7_a_column_is_exempted_without_saying_why
mutations.rationale: COORDINATE, FLOOR, INPUT_CONSTANT and NO_FLOOR_DEFINED become labels anyone can apply silently; the reason is what makes an exemption reviewable
